if (isset($_POST['check_extension_updates'])) {

        PortixSecurity::requirePostWithCsrf();
        $catalogue = \Portix\Maintenance\ExtensionUpdates::fetchCatalogue();
        $installed = ['module' => [], 'theme' => $themeById];
        foreach ($repositories->modules()->allOrdered() as $module) {
            $path = basename((string) $module['path']);
            $manifestFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/var/modules/' . $path . '/desc.xml';
            if (!is_readable($manifestFile)) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                $manifest = \Portix\Module\ModuleManifest::fromXml($manifestFile, $path);
                $installed['module'][$manifest['prefix']] = $manifest;
            } catch (RuntimeException) {
                continue;

        }
        $updates = \Portix\Maintenance\ExtensionUpdates::available($catalogue, $installed);
        $_SESSION['p3_update_catalogue'] = ['json' => $catalogue, 'expires' => time() + 300];
        unset($_SESSION['p3_core_release']);
        foreach ($updates as $update) {
            $template->addRow('extensionupdate', $update);
        }
        $updateStatus = $updates === [] ? 'extension_updates_none' : 'extension_updates_found';
    } catch (RuntimeException | JsonException) {
        $updateStatus = 'extension_updates_failed';
    }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Portix\Navigation;

use Portix\Module\ModuleManifest;
use Portix\Support\Translator;
use Throwable;

final class AdminNavigation
{
    public static function sections(string $root, array $modules, bool $isAdmin, bool $isRedactor, array $arguments, Translator $translator): array
    {
        $sections = ['writing' => [], 'management' => [], 'configuration' => []];
        if (!$isAdmin && !$isRedactor) {
            return $sections;
        }
        $add = static function (string $section, string $label, string $url, string $icon, string $match = '') use (&$sections, $translator): void {
            $sections[$section][] = [
                'name' => $translator->text($label, $label),
                'url' => $url,
                'icon' => $icon,
                'match' => $match !== '' ? $match : basename($url, '.html'),
                'current' => '',
            ];
        };
        if ($isAdmin) {
            $add('management', 'ux_accounts', 'Admin-users.html', 'users');
            $add('management', 'ux_modules', 'Admin-modmgr.html', 'boxes');
            $add('management', 'diagnostics_nav', 'Admin-diagnostics.html', 'activity');
            $add('configuration', 'ux_identity', 'Admin-config.html', 'settings', 'Admin-config');
            $add('configuration', 'ux_themes', 'Admin-config-themes.html', 'images');
            $add('configuration', 'ux_seo', 'Admin-config-seo.html', 'search');
            $add('configuration', 'ux_mail', 'Admin-config-mail.html', 'mail');
        }

        $places = [
            'articles' => ['writing', 'file-text'], 'news' => ['writing', 'newspaper'],
            'media' => ['writing', 'images'], 'menu' => ['writing', 'menu'],
            'footer' => ['writing', 'panel-bottom'], 'dwl' => ['writing', 'download'],
            'affiliation' => ['writing', 'dollar-sign'], 'contact' => ['management', 'mail'],
            'insights' => ['management', 'chart-bar'], 'search' => ['management', 'search'],
            'safety' => ['management', 'triangle-alert'],
        ];
        $settings = ['contact', 'affiliation', 'insights', 'safety'];
        foreach ($modules as $module) {
            $path = (string) $module['path'];
            if ($path !== basename($path) || $path === '.' || $path === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $directory = $root . '/var/modules/' . $path;
            if (empty($module['enabled']) || is_file($directory . '/AUTH')
                || ((string) $module['prefix'] !== 'news' && !is_file($directory . '/config.php'))) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                $manifest = ModuleManifest::fromXml($directory . '/desc.xml', $path);
            } catch (Throwable) {
                continue;
            }
            $access = $manifest['prefix'] === 'news' ? 'editor' : $manifest['admin_access'];
            if ($access === 'none' || (!$isAdmin && $access !== 'editor')) {
                continue;
            }
            $prefix = $manifest['prefix'];
            [$section, $icon] = $places[$prefix] ?? [$access === 'editor' ? 'writing' : 'management', 'boxes'];
            // Existing editor permissions continue to expose the Contact inbox.
            if (!$isAdmin && $section === 'management') {
                $section = 'writing';
            }
            $add($section, $manifest['name'], 'Admin-' . $prefix . '.html', $icon);
            if ($isAdmin && $prefix === 'articles') {
                $add('configuration', 'ux_settings_articles', 'Admin-articles-menu.html', 'menu');
            }
            if ($isAdmin && in_array($prefix, $settings, true)) {
                $add('configuration', 'ux_settings_' . $prefix, 'Admin-' . $prefix . '-settings.html', 'settings');
            }
        }

        $route = implode('-', $arguments);
        $active = null;
        $longest = -1;
        foreach ($sections as $section => $entries) {
            foreach ($entries as $index => $entry) {
                $match = $entry['match'];
                if (($route === $match || str_starts_with($route, $match . '-')) && strlen($match) > $longest) {
                    $active = [$section, $index];
                    $longest = strlen($match);
                }
            }
        }
        if ($active !== null) {
            $sections[$active[0]][$active[1]]['current'] = 'is-current';
        }
        return $sections;
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Portix\Maintenance;

use RuntimeException;

final class ExtensionUpdates
{
    private const BASE_URL = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/portix1/P3/main/distribution/';
    private const MAX_BYTES = 131072;

    public static function fetchCatalogue(): string
    {
        $context = stream_context_create(['http' => [
            'timeout' => 3,
            'follow_location' => 0,
        ]]);
        $json = @file_get_contents(self::BASE_URL . 'catalogue.json', false, $context, 0, self::MAX_BYTES + 1);
        if ($json === false || strlen($json) > self::MAX_BYTES) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Extension catalogue unavailable');
        }
        return $json;
    }

    public static function dashboard(string $root, array $modules, array $themes): array
    {
        $cached = $_SESSION['p3_update_catalogue'] ?? [];
        if (($cached['expires'] ?? 0) <= time()) {
            try {
                $json = self::fetchCatalogue();
                self::available($json, []);
                $cached = ['json' => $json, 'expires' => time() + 300];
            } catch (RuntimeException | \JsonException) {
                $cached = ['json' => null, 'expires' => time() + 60];
            }
            $_SESSION['p3_update_catalogue'] = $cached;
        }
        if ($cached['json'] === null) {
            return [];
        }

        $installed = ['theme' => array_column($themes, null, 'id'), 'module' => []];
        foreach ($modules as $module) {
            $path = basename((string) $module['path']);
            if (!preg_match('/\A[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,62}\z/', $path)) {
                continue;
            }
            $directory = $root . '/var/modules/' . $path;
            if (is_link($directory) || is_file($directory . '/AUTH') || !is_readable($directory . '/desc.xml')) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                $manifest = \Portix\Module\ModuleManifest::fromXml($directory . '/desc.xml', $path);
                $installed['module'][$manifest['prefix']] = $manifest;
            } catch (RuntimeException) {
                continue;
            }
        }
        $updates = [];
        foreach (self::available($cached['json'], $installed) as $update) {
            $updates[$update['kind']][$update['id']] = $update;
        }
        return $updates;
    }

    public static function core(string $installed): string
    {
        $cached = $_SESSION['p3_core_release'] ?? [];
        if (($cached['expires'] ?? 0) <= time()) {
            $context = stream_context_create(['http' => [
                'timeout' => 3, 'follow_location' => 0, 'user_agent' => 'Portix-P3',
            ]]);
            $json = @file_get_contents('https://api.github.com/repos/portix1/P3/releases/latest', false, $context, 0, self::MAX_BYTES);
            $release = $json === false ? null : json_decode($json, true, 32);
            $tag = $release['tag_name'] ?? '';
            $version = is_string($tag) && preg_match('/\Av?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\z/', $tag) ? ltrim($tag, 'v') : '';
            $cached = ['version' => $version, 'expires' => time() + ($version === '' ? 60 : 300)];
            $_SESSION['p3_core_release'] = $cached;
        }
        return $cached['version'] !== '' && version_compare($cached['version'], $installed, '>') ? $cached['version'] : '';
    }

    public static function available(string $json, array $installed): array
    {
        $catalogue = json_decode($json, true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        if (($catalogue['schema'] ?? null) !== 1 || !is_array($catalogue['packages'] ?? null)
            || !array_is_list($catalogue['packages'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Invalid extension catalogue');
        }

        $updates = [];
        foreach ($catalogue['packages'] as $package) {
            $kind = $package['kind'] ?? null;
            $id = $package['id'] ?? null;
            $version = $package['version'] ?? null;
            $file = $package['file'] ?? null;
            if (!in_array($kind, ['module', 'theme'], true) || !is_string($id)
                || !preg_match('/\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\z/', $id)
                || !is_string($version) || !preg_match('/\A[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+){1,3}(?:[-+][A-Za-z0-9.-]+)?\z/', $version)
                || !is_string($file) || !preg_match('/\A[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.zip\z/', $file)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Invalid extension catalogue entry');
            }

            $local = $installed[$kind][$id] ?? null;
            if ($local === null || $local['version'] === '' || !version_compare($version, $local['version'], '>')) {
                continue;
            }
            if (isset($updates[$kind][$id]) && !version_compare($version, $updates[$kind][$id]['version'], '>')) {
                continue;
            }
            $updates[$kind][$id] = [
                'kind' => $kind,
                'id' => $id,
                'name' => $local['name'],
                'installed' => $local['version'],
                'version' => $version,
                'url' => self::BASE_URL . rawurlencode($file),
            ];
        }

        return array_merge(array_values($updates['module'] ?? []), array_values($updates['theme'] ?? []));
    }
}
